title: Acquire and release publication
summary: Publish a payload once using a release store and an acquire load on a readiness flag.
triggers: C++ memory ordering and happens-before for one-time publication
hand off an immutable payload via an atomic readiness flag
prompts: Publish a result from one thread and read the non-atomic data after observing its atomic ready flag.
Explain which operations make the payload read safe before the producer is joined.
invariant: The producer writes the payload before the release store. A reader that observes that store with an acquire load reads afterward, and the producer never writes the payload again.
mantra: Write the data; release the flag; acquire before reading.
pitfalls: A relaxed load of the flag alone does not synchronize access to the payload.
Resetting the flag does not make this a reusable slot; another write could race with a reader.
This loop polls. Prefer a blocking primitive when the wait can be long. A passing run alone cannot prove memory ordering.
